channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Cameron Reddish | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Cameron Reddish from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on Cameron Reddish
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Schlenk on Reddish:

“Cam had come to us during the offseason & expressed the desire to maybe get to a situation where he could have a little bigger role.”

Travis Schlenk on Cameron Reddish, Jan 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Jalen Johnson on Cameron Reddish
item.description:
Jalen Johnson on Hawks:

“They're a crazy young talented group. Like it's so fun to watch. Trae he was a bucket the whole playoffs and he was just entertainment, pure entertainment. I'm excited to play with him, the other guys, Cam Reddish. It's just great young talented group.”

Jalen Johnson on Cameron Reddish, Jul 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @CVivlamoreAJC.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Cameron Reddish
item.description:
Nate McMillan on Cam Reddish:

“I've only coached Cam for 2 or 3 games ... The kid has a lot of talent.”

Nate McMillan on Cameron Reddish, Jun 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Lloyd Pierce on Cameron Reddish
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Lloyd Pierce on Cam Reddish's left wrist sprain:

“He's better. I think there was huge swelling yesterday and some tenderness in his left pinky, and then today it was a 30-40% improvement... He had better grip with it today, but not quite there yet.”

Lloyd Pierce on Cameron Reddish, Nov 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Trae Young on Cameron Reddish
item.description:
Trae Young on Cam Reddish at his NBPA camp:

“With us being able to get Cam at 10, I think that’s a big steal. I thought when we traded back and had the 10th pick I didn’t think we were going to get Cam because I saw him play in high school and his talent. Us getting him is big.”

Trae Young on Cameron Reddish, Jul 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on Cameron Reddish
item.description:
Kevin Chouinard:Schlenk:

“(Cam Reddish) was a guy we identified early in the process, all the way back to when he was in high school.”

Travis Schlenk on Cameron Reddish, Jun 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.
